newsitem.title: UK: BZW, FTSE International launch UK market review.
newsitem.headline: BZW, FTSE International launch UK market review.

text.p: FTSE International, which manages the FTSE 100 and other UK stock indices, on Wednesday said it had teamed up with brokerage BZW to publish a monthly analysis of UK stocks and market indices.

To be distributed to 1,500 institutions and analysts, the FTSE UK Monthly Review will include listings and analysis of stocks in all FTSE indices, stock and sector weightings and a breakdown of the UK market by value.
"We are constantly looking for ways to increase awarenewss and understnding of the FTSE Actuaries shares indices," said Mark Makepeace, managing director of FTSE International.

"This new initiative with BZW will benefit all market participants," Makepeace said. "Much of the information in the UK monthly review will be new to investors and analysts and will significantly improve the transparency of the indices, setting a new higher standard for index calculations."
Bill Harrison, chief executive of BZW which is sponsoring the publication, said the review would be "tremendously beneficial" to clients.
"The fund management shift towards sophisticated index, trend tracking and value-based investment decision-making... will make the review an indispensible reference," Harrison said.
